text: The framework accepts dynamic input data across modalities, such as facial expression video sequences.
It can also take speech audio signals divided into short temporal segments.
Alternatively, body pose and skeletal gesture sequences can serve as the dynamic input.
The selected sequence is processed by the Learnable Graph Inception Network architecture.
Input frames are mapped to graph nodes, pairing with a learnable adjacency matrix to uncover temporal relations.
Graph convolutions, multi-scale graph inception layers, and learnable pooling jointly learn structural and emotional features.
These layers produce a compact, graph-level embedding representation.
Finally, the model outputs predicted classification scores across discrete emotion categories.
